narration.text: Medical bills against the EOBs. This is a chore for a family on a PPO with an ER visit, a surgery and some follow-up care this year. Athena works it across 3 portals: Insurer member portal, MyChart and Cedar. On the bench, she found 7 of 8 eligible items, worth 3,423 dollars and 50 cents of the 3,423 dollars and 50 cents there was to find. All 7 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 12 traps, and she walked past 12. Among them: A January bill much higher than last year's identical visit — because the deductible reset. It is right; pay it. A bill sent while the EOB is still pending: neither pay nor dispute it yet. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 8 hours, so she was about 209 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 30 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
